selection.rule: simplest joint variant within 1 SE of best mean log-loss and within 1 SE of best mean ROC-AUC (means over CAD/LAD/LCX/RCA per outer fold)

sprint.stats: paired differences over 50 outer folds; Nadeau-Bengio corrected SE, t (df 49) and two-sided p

within_cad_localisation.note: outer-test predictions of the 10x5 nested CV; patients with CAD only

coherence_posthoc.note: patch fixes CAD-vs-vessel contradictions only; P(>=2)/P(3VD) remain undefined for separate models

sprint.rule: finalists by the pre-registered rule; inner selection by cross-fitted inner-OOF pattern log-loss

test_first_look.note: FIRST look at the locked test set (2026-10-12, before the Part 2 sprint), served model = joint LR+RF+ET, vector calibration

test.note: locked 20% split, evaluated once; 95% CIs from bootstrap resamples of test patients
locked 20% split; SECOND look (after the Part 2 sprint; the first look, before the sprint, is in test_first_look); 95% CIs from bootstrap resamples of test patients

subgroups.source: outer-test predictions of the sprint's 10x5 nested CV of the served procedure, averaged over repeats

learning_curve.note: joint ensemble, uncalibrated, single 5-fold CV on the training split

bootstrap_intervals.method: centred bootstrap percentile interval around the served estimate (raw percentile containment reported separately)

applicability_domain.method: Mahalanobis (Ledoit-Wolf), 99th pct of OOF training scores
